This is a Swift package (a library fork), not an app: no binary is distributed from here. SwiftPM fetches BitByteData (MIT, the library's dependency) itself in each consumer, and the apps that link it carry its notice in About > Licenses (Demion, Arkheion, Skopeion, Pinakeion; see vendored.json consumers). SwiftCLI (MIT) is used only by the swcomp test tool (Package.swift), which is not built for distribution.
